_comment: FNIRSI 2D15P V2.7.0.7 — DMM-first mod. Offsets are FILE offsets (MCU addr - 0x11000). See notes/re-plan.md 2026-10-05 for derivation.

patches.note: Goal 1: boot page = 1 (DMM) instead of 2 (scope) when config magic is 0x55. init @0x3668E: movs r3,#2 -> movs r3,#1
Goal 3a: DDS key handler @0x2CA70: 'cmp r0,#3' -> 'cmp r0,#1' so pressing it on the DMM page returns to scope
Goal 3b: DDS key handler @0x2CA7E: 'b.w 0x49880' (enter DDS) -> 'b.w 0x49924' (enter DMM); touch-menu DDS entry untouched
